svg.title: How SintBot works
svg.desc: Group (Feishu, Slack or WeCom) → SintBot on your machine (message loop, one group · one project, permissions · redaction) → agent runner (Claude Code or Codex, headless in the project directory) → the model chosen per group (Claude, GPT, GLM, DeepSeek, MiniMax, Kimi). Progress and results flow back to the group.
